import unreal
w=unreal.get_editor_subsystem(unreal.UnrealEditorSubsystem).get_game_world()
actors=unreal.GameplayStatics.get_all_actors_of_class(w,unreal.Actor)
pc=next(a for a in actors if "ShootPlayerController" in a.get_class().get_name())
enemy=next(a for a in actors if "EnemyBotCharacter" in a.get_class().get_name())
ps=pc.get_editor_property("player_state")
src=next(c for c in ps.get_components_by_class(unreal.ActorComponent) if "AbilitySystem" in c.get_class().get_name())
dst=next(c for c in enemy.get_components_by_class(unreal.ActorComponent) if "AbilitySystem" in c.get_class().get_name())
health=next(a for a in dst.get_all_attributes() if str(a.get_editor_property("attribute_name"))=="Health")
def hv(): return dst.get_gameplay_attribute_value(health)[0]
print("HEALTH_START",hv())
for label,path in [("Rifle","/Game/Weapons/Rifle/GE_Damage_Rifle"),("Pistol","/Game/Weapons/Pistol/GE_Damage_Pistol"),("ShotgunPellet","/Game/Weapons/Shotgun/GE_Damage_Shotgun")]:
    ge=unreal.load_asset(path).generated_class()
    spec=src.make_outgoing_spec(ge,1.0,src.make_effect_context())
    before=hv()
    handle=src.apply_gameplay_effect_spec_to_target(spec,dst)
    after=hv()
    print("DAMAGE_CASE",label,"BEFORE",before,"AFTER",after,"DELTA",before-after,"HANDLE",handle)
